provenance.public_window: The hillclimb changed only dead_min_run, dead_trim, dead_close and dead_outside_m. It scored files on the public window as a correctness check, never inside a selection rule: tier0_v2, tier0_v7 and tier0_v0 at 09:32 and 09:36 IST on 2026-10-24, and tier0_v8 at 11:40 IST. Every experiment from E17 on, selection rules v3 and v4, spell_merge_frames, the spell_push fields and switch_penalty came after the first read. Inherited from tier0_v1: Selection read only the Metrica dev worlds in sweep_worlds. The marginal temper grid {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2} was set from a public-window smoke test that put temper's useful range at 0.01 to 0.1. The m2 worlds merge Metrica spells under 2 s because raw Metrica spells are much shorter than the public window's, though 2 s was not fitted to the window. The decoder dead_bias 1.0 was selected from a {1, 3} axis whose 1.0 is the flat default, argued partly from a public-window count. These choices were committed on 2026-10-21. EVALUATION.md had said since 2026-09-24 to use the window to check correctness and never to choose between two versions. Upstream f8f2629 (2026-10-23) made RULES.md say the window is not training data and not a tuning set. v1 won this sweep on dev but was set aside the same day, on CHALLENGE.md and public-window figures (23 predicted possessions against 17, spellF1 0.310 against 0.412). On controlled-possession dev worlds it later lost to v0 at 5 s (-0.026 spellF1) and tied at 3 s. This public_window text was added by hand on 2026-10-24, and the command above does not write it. See possession/DESIGN.md, Measurements and constant provenance.
provenance.selection: Pre-registered rule v2 (.audit/hillclimb-2026-10-24.tsv): candidates are v1's chain with dead_min_run {101, 126} x dead_trim {0, 12, 25, 37, 50} x dead_close {0, 100, 150, 200, 300}. Synthetic groups (Metrica m0, h1p3, h3p3 and IDSSE m0, m2 at generator dead_bias 1, 2.6, 4, seeds 0-4) only veto: a candidate's seed-mean pooled spellF1 margin over baseline_smooth50 must be at least the incumbent 101/50/0's minus 0.003 in every group, because the renewal generator switches masks at label boundaries. The minimum over native PFF m0 and m2 on odd-indexed games ranks; ties within 0.003 go to the higher synthetic minimum. Even-indexed PFF games and seeds 15-24 only confirm. Game indices count from 1: the odd-indexed games are pff.GAMES[0::2].
